Observation No. 1
Page 78
Audit Observations
The reliability of the reported Cash in Bank - Local
Currency, Current Account (CIB-LCCA) account
amounting to P8.072 billion is unreliable due to the
following:
Audit Recommendations
1.17.We recommended that Management
require:
a.The CTO to:
Immediately forward to the OCAT the supporting
documents for the recording of necessary
adjusting entries;
Regularly coordinate with the OCAT to facilitate
reconciliation of cashbook balances with the
OCAT SLS for CIB accounts; and
Promptly communicate noted discrepancies with
the OCAT so adjustments, if any, can be recorded
in a timely manner both in the books and BRS.
a.Existence of outstanding reconciling Items in the
Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS) totaling
P155.799 million and P142.181 million for additions
and deductions, respectively, which remain
unadjusted in the books; b. Existence of variance
totaling P96.510 million between the Subsidiary
Ledgers (SL) balance of the OCAT and cashbook
balance of the City Treasurer's Office (CTO); and
P160.925 million between the St. and the confirmed
balances from Authorized Government Depository
Banks (AGDBs); and c. Existence of bank accounts for
expropriated properties that were opened and
confirmed by the bank as savings accounts and were
recorded as CIB - LCCA under the General Fund (GF)
books totaling P145.025 million. The above
conditions resulted in the misstatement of affected
accounts contrary to Paragraph 27 of International
Public Sector Accounting Standard (IPSAS) I,
Item 3.0 of COA Circular No. 96-011 and Section 20 of balances.
COA Circular No. 92-382 dated July 3, 1992.
b. The OCAT to:
Ensure that BRS are prepared for all active bank
accounts and reconciling items identified in the
reports are promptly recorded in the books; and
Ensure that identified reconciling items in the
BRS are immediately adjusted in the books to
prevent accumulation of unadjusted variances
between records of the OCAT, CTO and AGDB
Action Plan
AGENCY ACTION PLAN
The CTO committed to furnish the OCAT
with the reconciling items reflected in
theri cash books for reconciliation of CAD
records.
